players.name: GLiDE 2B [repeat 1]
players.note: Fastino's GLiDE 2B (Hugging Face fastino/GLiDE-2B @ 00f122c120cdeed82284106cb77d9bab5a50ad16, Fastino Community License) on our GPU through the server its repository ships (python -m glide.server; env ~/envs/glide-family: CPython 3.12.13, torch 2.14.0+cu130, transformers 5.17.0, flash-linear-attention 0.5.2), BF16, GLIDE_MAX_BATCH=1 (one request at a time), no model field (the server passes only state and questions to the model), 255-way code readout; 255 options per request (the league's rule; longer lists split); never truncates: a question prompt over GLIDE_MAX_LEN 40,000 tokens is refused (422). League 1's longest stored request (251 options) is 28,323 tokens of its tokenizer with the card's prompt; none over.
